releaseNotes:
fix(android): expose integrations in alpha20 settings

Jarvis 19.0.0-alpha20 adds a top-level expandable Integrations section to the existing com.aaron.jarvisvoice app and uses versionCode 190200 so devices reporting alpha19 can receive an in-place update.

The release retains the verified account/integration platform, Google OAuth architecture, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Contacts, durable email monitoring, external-agent/account support, permission enforcement, action receipts, and security hardening. Google remains Setup required until OAuth credentials are configured securely in Jarvis Core.

Runtime UI tests verify Settings routing, manifest/deep-link resolution, truthful provider states, and the alpha19-to-alpha20 OTA path. The release workflow now inspects the compiled APK manifest and bytecode before publication.
